title: Haptic Beat Relay
summary: Send tactile beat cues to a friend's phone and score the taps they send back.
user: Friends and rhythm-game makers who want a simple local cue relay without an online account.
smallest_useful_product: A host loads a local beat loop; a second device joins with a six-character code, receives vibration cues, taps back on-beat, and sees a shared accuracy meter.
constraints: Web vibration and controller haptics depend on browser and device support. Relay only ephemeral room state. Include no copyrighted music.
